cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

mechanism: A accepts a request through an interpretation that protects A superior role or excuses A labor, treating B practical questions as challenges A alone can settle.
confusable: D167 redefines any term; D191 must interpret an actual cited policy to secure authority or exemption before agreeing to help.
comparison: Senior hall volunteer recasts mopping as supervision; Christmas host counts hosting under a shared-effort custom to avoid cooking.
seedUse: Both full instructions and four canonical seeds read, including current canonical D191 seeds rather than treating pending single candidates as approved. Preserve cited policy and resulting exemption.
